title: fix(@angular/build): allow any `CHROME_BIN` for vitest playwright provider

target.summary: Setting launchOptions.executablePath from CHROME_BIN on the shared Playwright provider causes non-Chromium browsers (such as Firefox or WebKit) to launch the Chrome binary and fail when CHROME_BIN is set in the environment.
notes: faulty launchOptions setting CHROME_BIN as executablePath unconditionally for all Playwright instances
